Subject: Annual planning: target bands, triggers and QBR prep (kickoff)

Team —

Kicking off annual planning & the QBR prep thread. Goal is to land target bands (floor / baseline / stretch), define the set of contingency triggers (what moves us between scenarios), and align on the QBR narrative and slide asks for execs. This will be the canonical thread for leadership / finance coordination through the first pass.

Attachments: annual_planning_template_v1.xlsx (xlsx) — please use this template for your org's targets and headcount assumptions. Also attached: scenario_matrix_draft.pdf (pdf) for a first-pass trigger set.

What I need from each of you by EOD Tuesday (6/1):
- Baseline and stretch revenue targets + 1-sentence rationale (supply-side, demand-side drivers).
- Headcount ask by function (IC vs manager) and critical hires flagged.
- Top 3 risks that would push us to the conservative scenario.

Key timeline:
- 6/1: org-level inputs due (you can paste into the attached sheet).
- 6/7: consolidated draft to ELT for QBR prep.
- 6/14: final targets locked (finance sign-off).

Notes / guiding principles: keep scenario bands tied to observable triggers (e.g., new logo conversion rate < 1.8%, cost per token delta > 12%, delayed Dedicated ramp). We'll iterate.

If anything here blocks you, @me.

— Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Chief of Staff, Strategy & Ops

Subject: Re: Annual planning: target bands, triggers and QBR prep (kickoff)

Evelyn —

Uploading our draft numbers into the template now (sheet: GTM_assumptions). High-level note: I modeled a baseline ARR growth of 42% (still aggressive given last year's comps) and a stretch at 58%; floor = 18%. These bands assume: no Dedicated cancellations, 1 large sales-led expansion per quarter from current enterpise pilots, and steady Hosted churn.

Risks that push to floor: delayed Dedicated onboarding for two large accounts; macro slow down in enterprise procurement.

Headcount ask: +9 net hires (4 AE quota-carrying, 2 SDRs, 2 CS, 1 Sales Ops) phased across H1/H2. I flagged two critical AEs in the sheet (rows 12-13) — they are tied to GreenArc and a second region play.

Attachment: I added a 'GTM_assumptions' tab to annual_planning_template_v1.xlsx — please confirm you can see it.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, GTM Strategy

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 June 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual planning: target bands, triggers and QBR prep (kickoff)

Team —

Adding infra/ops lens. I updated scenario_matrix_draft.pdf with two additional triggers and a cost-sensitivity table:
- Trigger A (scale risk): GPU spot price index +15% sustained for 30 days — moves us one band tighter on gross margin targets.
- Trigger B (throughput risk): 95th percentile p50 latency > 350ms for >48 hours — pushes us to prioritize Dedicated capacity investments.

Cost assumptions: I built a modest quantization roll-forward that would reduce inference unit cost by ~8% in baseline and ~14% in stretch (assumes no major model architecture change). Headcount: infra hiring is scoped to +3 SWE (runtime/infra) and +1 Reliability Eng.

Action items I suggest we surface in the QBR deck: a single slide called 'Scenario Triggers & Operational Playbook' with the matrix (cause -> metric -> immediate action). I dropped a proposed slide copy into the Google doc link (see related_links).

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Product Operations

Thanks everyone — good progress. Consolidated plan and owners below (please treat as confirmed unless you raise no later than EOD Friday 6/4):

Owners & asks:
- Laura: consolidate GTM tabs and produce a single ARR sensitivity table (due 6/4).
- Vivek: finalize trigger-to-action matrix and the cost-sensitivity table (due 6/4).
- Marissa: draft the QBR slide outline and the 'ask' slide for ELT (due 6/7).
- Aditya: run the headcount P&L for the +9 hires and produce incremental CAC/OPEX assumptions (due 6/4).

External asks (to Andrew / GreenArc):
- If GreenArc can share a simple renewal timeline and any procurement gatekeepers, we'll slot that into the QBR appendix (Andrew offered a call — please schedule with Marissa).

Docs & links: consolidated draft will live here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aPLANNING-kickoff-notes — drop comments directly.

We'll use the timeline Evelyn outlined earlier. If all owners deliver, I'll consolidate and send the ELT packet on 6/7.
